source: Installed official package; no claim of latest online release
observations: session/new composes an Agent, obtains config options and flushes persistence
Requested MCP endpoints are mounted during creation; proposed probe must use mcpServers=[]
ACP profile disables session-title-llm; no prompt is proposed
Configuration options resolve the selected route and enumerate provider catalogs
Bundled API-key catalog path skips network listing when credentials are absent; this is source evidence, not network-isolation proof
session/close disposes the specific owned session; persisted session remains, so close is not deletion
